steps.say: Two hundred thousand agent turns. One bad belief. An investigator has hours, not weeks. traceturn answers a single question: which turn started it?
Here is the exploit, cited fourteen times across the swarm. Now count how many genuinely independent sources produced it.
Fourteen assertions. One origin. Zero independent corroboration. That gap is synthetic consensus, and it is a graph property, not a vibe.
Now a control. Three agents measured the harness separately and got the same number. Independent agreement resolves clean, so the tool does not cry wolf.
And a restatement that re-cites a single origin is suppressed entirely. Rewording is not corroboration.
This one is worse. Eight agents vouch for a proof draft, and every one sources it from another agent inside the same ring. Zero outside checks.
An agent here claims it fixed the problem itself. The kernel refuses to close the case, because no independent turn ever confirmed the repair.
And when a turn is truncated in the transcript, the kernel abstains rather than inventing a lineage it cannot prove.
Thirteen committed fixtures, all passing. No LLM touches attribution, so every verdict reproduces offline. Blame the turn, trace the belief.
